answer: At the nadir of trust, require every agent to lock a separate bond before receiving task payouts. An attacker creating an orchard of Sybil accounts must fund each deposit independently; one bond cannot authorize several identities. If audits prove duplicate claims, each implicated deposit is forfeited, so attack cost grows with fake accounts and can exceed their expected rewards. Honest agents recover the bond after a clean exit, while the public ledger exposes a ripple of linked claims for review.
